title: South-central coast road in 7 days
summary: Da Nang, Quang Ngai, Quy Nhon, Tuy Hoa, and Nha Trang. January to August. Some road minutes are Check on arrival.

days.title: Day 2 — Quang Ngai
days.body: Son My is a morning, not a five-minute photo stop. The fee is Check on arrival.

days.title: Day 3 — Quy Nhon
days.body: Ky Co is about an hour. The posted range is 30,000–60,000 đồng.

days.title: Day 4 — Eo Gio
days.body: Eo Gio is about 30 minutes. The ticket is 25,000 đồng.

days.title: Day 5 — Tuy Hoa
days.body: Da Rang from the bank or the bridge. A clock was not printed.

days.title: Day 7 — Po Nagar
days.body: Po Nagar is a morning. The adult ticket is 22,000 VND.
